title: Sailboat at Twilight Lake
description: A vibrant landscape painting shows a small orange-sailed boat gliding across a calm lake that perfectly reflects the sky. In the background, a powerful waterfall cascades down a green mountainside beneath a dramatic sky split between bright blue day and purple twilight with a large moon and crescent.
prompt: A serene fantasy landscape with a small sailboat with bright orange sail floating on a glassy lake that mirrors the sky. A large turquoise waterfall flows down a lush green mountainside on the left. The sky transitions from bright blue with clouds to deep purple twilight with a glowing full moon, crescent moon, and stars. Lone pine tree on a small island, distant snow-capped mountains, soft mist, vibrant colors, reflective water.
